title: The Dispensation of Bahá’u’lláh

temporal.endNote: Note 62 of the Kitáb-i-Aqdas dates the beginning of the thousand-year minimum to October 1852. The minimum is not a forecast of an endpoint.

summary: A continuing dispensation with a stated minimum duration, not a predicted end.
editorialNote: The 1853 boundary in God Passes By is a historical chapter period, not the boundary used here for the dispensation.
